nodes.label: Anti-Doubling Matrix
nodes.rationale: Matrix mapping each data source (FixedCostOccurrence INCOME, CardInvoice, FixedCostOccurrence EXPENSE with paidInsideCard flag, Transaction EXPENSE, ImportedTransaction, BankAccountMovement) to whether it counts toward suggested income, committed expenses, or realized variable expenses. Prevents double counting.

nodes.label: Dual Schema Concept
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL schema with @db.Decimal(19,2) for production, SQLite schema for dev/test. Each generates separate client. src/lib/prisma.ts detects adapter at runtime via DATABASE_URL. Tradeoff: tests without PostgreSQL (fast CI) but dual maintenance and schema drift risk.

nodes.label: Per-Route Auth Pattern (No Middleware)
nodes.rationale: No middleware.ts used. Each route handler calls auth() individually and returns 401. Automated test uses import.meta.glob to discover ALL routes and verify 401 without session. Prevents regressions but requires boilerplate per handler.

nodes.label: JWT Invalidation via passwordChangedAt
nodes.rationale: NextAuth v5 with JWT strategy (not database sessions). Callback JWT verifies dbUser.passwordChangedAt vs token.loginAt. If password changed after token issuance, session is invalidated. Zero DB queries to validate session. Compatible with Vercel stateless deployment.

nodes.label: PrismaDecimal Monetary Precision
nodes.rationale: Values persisted as Decimal(19,2) in PostgreSQL and Decimal in SQLite. All internal arithmetic uses PrismaDecimal (toMoney, sumMoney, subtractMoney). Conversion to number only at API/UI boundaries. UI formats with Intl.NumberFormat pt-BR BRL.

nodes.label: Changelog-as-Code Pattern
nodes.rationale: src/content/releases.ts stores releases as typed readonly array. Page renders from data directly. scripts/generate-changelog.ts generates CHANGELOG.md from typed data. release.test.ts validates consistency. Single source of truth for UI and Markdown.

nodes.label: Dual Rate Limiter Pattern
nodes.rationale: Two rate limiters: Login (active everywhere, 5 failures/email + 25/IP, 15min window) and Request (production only via NODE_ENV check, applied to register and forgot-password). Both use LoginAttempt table with SHA-256 keys. Tests unaffected by request rate limits.

nodes.label: Dual Database Pattern (PostgreSQL + SQLite)
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL in production (schema.prisma with @db.Decimal(19,2)) and SQLite in dev/test (schema.sqlite.prisma with native Decimal). src/lib/prisma.ts detects adapter at runtime via DATABASE_URL prefix.

nodes.label: NextAuth v5 JWT Strategy
nodes.rationale: Each API route calls auth() individually (no middleware). Invalidation via passwordChangedAt on User model. Protected by automated test (api-auth-guard.test.ts).

nodes.label: Connection Pool Management (Vercel + VPS)
nodes.rationale: Vercel serverless multiplies pool per instance. DATABASE_POOL_MAX=3, VPS max_connections=50. Idle session timeout 60s, idle-in-transaction timeout 60s. PrismaPg pool configured with max, idleTimeoutMillis, connectionTimeoutMillis.

nodes.label: Dashboard Performance Optimization
nodes.rationale: Endpoints went from 2-11s to ~1-2s. Optimizations: batch ensureFinancialMonth/ensureFixedCostOccurrences, groupBy for invoices, single query for occurrences across months, aggregated endpoint /api/dashboard/summary. Added indexes on Transaction, CardInvoice, FixedCost, FixedCostOccurrence, BankAccountMovement.

nodes.label: Prisma+SQLite skipDuplicates Incompatibility
nodes.rationale: Prisma+SQLite does not accept skipDuplicates; throws runtime error. Workaround: use upsert in loop or manual existence check.

nodes.label: Database Roles (finly_app/finly_runtime/finly_migrator/finly_owner)
nodes.rationale: Runtime roles (finly_app, finly_runtime) cannot create tables. finly_migrator only used at deploy time with DDL permissions. finly_owner is object owner without login. Separation ensures principle of least privilege.

nodes.label: Dashboard monthlyPlan Single Fetch
nodes.rationale: Dashboard consumes monthlyPlan in the existing /api/dashboard/summary fetch with no additional request or client-side financial calculation. Summary obtains canonical projection with userId from session and the same asOf used to validate the D-17 window.

nodes.label: Deterministic Visual Fixture Pattern
nodes.rationale: Canonical August 2026 values use deterministic network fixture in visual journey. A/B isolation and D-17 window traverse real auth, API and database.

nodes.label: Fail-Closed Production Build Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Build in production fails closed without MIGRATE_DATABASE_URL. migrate deploy and smoke must terminate before next build. Smoke distinguishes DML, CREATE and ALTER capacity correctly.

nodes.label: Daily Safe Limit (Limite Diário Seguro)
nodes.rationale: The primary indicator derived from variable available value divided by remaining days. Non-negative, redistributed across remaining days, not accumulated from prior days.

nodes.label: Plano do Mês Feature (MonthlyPlan)
nodes.rationale: MonthlyPlan is a per-user per-month configuration entity with incomeOverride Decimal?, savingsGoal Decimal, and safetyMargin Decimal. Unique by (userId, month). Derived values not persisted.

nodes.label: Pure Calculator Pattern (calculateMonthlyPlan)
nodes.rationale: A pure deterministic function receiving centavos/normalized monetary values and an injectable reference date asOf. No Prisma dependency. Returns MonthlyPlanProjection with projectedSavings, variableAvailable, dailySafeLimit, status NORMAL/ATTENTION/RISK.

nodes.label: America/Sao_Paulo Canonical Timezone
nodes.rationale: Business day uses America/Sao_Paulo canonical timezone with injectable asOf. Not trusting host timezone. Requires @date-fns/tz@1.5.0 installation. Avoids toISOString() UTC which may shift the day in Brazil.

nodes.label: ASVS Security Categories (V2/V3/V4/V5/V11)
nodes.rationale: Applicable ASVS categories for the MonthlyPlan feature: V2 Authentication (auth() in GET/PUT), V3 Session Management (existing Auth.js), V4 Access Control (userId from session, cross-tenant filtering), V5 Input Validation (Zod allowlist, month format, Decimal limits), V11 Business Logic (anti-double-counting, status limits server-side).

nodes.label: Known Threat Patterns for Next.js/Prisma Finance API
nodes.norm_label: known threat patterns for next.js/prisma finance api
nodes.rationale: BOLA (session as tenant, composite filters, never trust client userId), Mass assignment (strict Zod schema, only 3 financial fields), Negative/NaN/Enormous values (finite validation, non-negative, 2 decimals), Month DoS (validate and limit supported window), Cross-tenant data leak (no query by month without userId), Race condition on month creation (unique constraint + upsert), Shared cache of authenticated response (Route Handler dynamic, no public cache).

nodes.label: Prisma Decimal Arithmetic Pattern
nodes.rationale: All internal arithmetic uses PrismaDecimal: toMoney, sumMoney, subtractMoney. Conversion to number only at API/UI boundaries. Division and display rounding defined/tested in centavos.

nodes.label: Decision D-16: Transaction Boundary
nodes.rationale: Transaction represents only loose income/expense. Internal payments of invoices and fixed charges use BankAccountMovement. ImportedTransaction details the invoice and does not enter separately. No fuzzy deduplication.

nodes.label: Decision D-17: Query Window
nodes.rationale: Queries and mutations accept months only from start of prior year to end of next year relative to asOf in America/Sao_Paulo timezone. Outside this window the API rejects before materializing recurrences.

nodes.label: Dual Schema Rule
nodes.rationale: Every structural change must be repeated in both PostgreSQL and SQLite schemas. The only monetary difference is @db.Decimal(19,2) in PostgreSQL. package.json confirms dual generation in prisma:generate.

nodes.label: Daily Safe Limit Formula
nodes.rationale: saldo_planejado = receita_prevista - gastos_comprometidos; disponivel_variavel = saldo_planejado - meta_economia - margem_seguranca - gastos_variaveis_realizados; limite_diario_seguro = max(0, disponivel_variavel) / dias_restantes

nodes.label: Adaptive Daily Limit Redistribution
nodes.rationale: PMES-008: Unspent values must not appear as accumulated balance the next day; the limit must be redistributed across all remaining days. Above-pace spending reduces future limits.

nodes.label: Dark/Light Theme Toggle System
nodes.rationale: CSS custom properties for both dark and light themes via data-theme attribute. Theme toggle persists via localStorage key 'cinema-theme'. Transition class applied during switch for smooth color transitions.

nodes.label: Component → Hook → Service → Prisma → DB
nodes.rationale: Data flow pattern: Component NEVER touches Prisma directly. All financial queries must be isolated by userId.

nodes.label: Feature-Based Architecture
nodes.rationale: App Router for routes, Features (18) for domain logic, Lib for infra, Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL (prod) and SQLite (tests).

nodes.label: Feature-Based Architecture
nodes.rationale: Each feature in src/features/ is an autonomous module with business logic, validation and tests co-located by domain. No barrel exports. Services accept optional PrismaClient for testability. Flow: Component -> Hook -> Service -> Prisma -> DB.

nodes.label: Dual Prisma Schema Pattern
nodes.rationale: SQLite for dev/test, PostgreSQL for prod. Both schemas must be kept aligned. Monetary values as Decimal(19,2).

nodes.label: Multi-Tenant Isolation by userId
nodes.rationale: Every financial query must be isolated by userId. Payments and reversals must maintain unique bank movement linkage.

nodes.label: setState inside useEffect Lint Rule
nodes.rationale: If state can be calculated from props or other states, use useState(initialValue) or useMemo instead of useEffect + setState. Avoids extra render and lint error set-state-in-effect.
